```python
def merge_sorted(left, right):
    result = []
    i, j = 0, 0
    while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
        if left[i] < right[j]:
            result.append(left[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            result.append(right[j])
            j += 1
    result.extend(left[i:])
    result.extend(right[j:])
    return result
```

The approach is to iterate through both lists simultaneously, appending the smaller element to the result list and advancing the corresponding pointer. Once one list is exhausted, the remaining elements of the other list are appended to the result list.
